title: feat: Add new event
summary: Adds an integration event in CheckVATDateCZL of VAT Date Handler CZL so partners can adjust when Original Doc. VAT Date CZL is required. The PR states the check should only apply when the document is invoiced, not when a purchase receipt is posted.
key_points: New integration event in VAT Date Handler CZL CheckVATDateCZL
Lets partners adjust the Original Doc. VAT Date CZL check condition without modifying standard code
Motivated by the field being required at purchase receipt posting although it only matters for invoicing
quote: There is currently no integration event in VAT Date Handler CZL.CheckVATDateCZL allowing partners to adjust this condition without modifying standard code directly.
